summary: Phase-3 Transaction Correctness testing complete. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration37_phase3_classifier.py with 45 tests spanning unit (transaction_classifier + file_provider CSV parsing) and integration (list/classify/match-transfers endpoints, Coach snippet, delete-account cascade). 44/45 PASSED, 1 SKIPPED (accounts/all shape — user alex+test1 has no linked accounts so field shape could not be inspected; endpoint itself returned 200 OK with empty list, confirmed via curl — no regression). Zero failures. All Phase-3 requirements verified: Plaid PFC classification (TRANSFER_IN/OUT, LOAN_PAYMENTS variants), legacy category hierarchy, description keyword fallback, user-override precedence (both 'none' clear and 'transfer' promote), Chase Description>Details priority, BoA Debit+Credit combo, Post/Posting Date aliases, Transaction Type direction flip, _parse_csv tuple shape + partial-file resilience (bad rows skipped, not fatal), include_transfers=false filter, PATCH classify with 401/404/400/200 + null-revert + 'none'-disable + IDOR guard (user B → 404), match-transfers pairing across accounts with paired_external_id linked bidirectionally + override='none' rows correctly excluded from matching, Coach build_context_snippet strips all three system_category kinds, delete-account cascades bank_transactions to zero.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L971 has a dead-code expression: `'system_category_override': {'$in': [None, ''], '$exists': False} if False else None`. The ternary is `if False` so it always evaluates to `None`, meaning the initial `cursor` query on L967-972 filters to rows where system_category_override == null literally. This first `cursor` is never even iterated — the code re-queries via `all_rows` on L974-977 without any override filter. The dead cursor + confusing ternary should be removed for clarity (no functional bug, but reviewer-hostile).
server.py match-transfers loops O(N^2) over `all_rows` (capped at 5000). Fine for <10k rows/user, but consider bucketing by abs(amount) for larger accounts; noted in code comment already.

transaction_classifier.classify_system: an invalid override string (neither in SYSTEM_CATEGORIES nor 'none') silently falls through to auto-detection. Acceptable behaviour but could log a warning to catch client bugs.

file_provider._parse_csv: a row where _parse_amount returns 0 (unparseable number) with a non-empty description is NOT skipped — it's persisted with amount=0. Consider adding to skipped for user visibility.

success_rate.backend: 97.7% (44 pass / 45 total, 1 skipped due to empty account list)
